shortDescription: Manage LDAP Policies for Cisco Intersight

options.name: api_bearer_token
options.description: Bearer token for OAuth2 authentication with the Intersight API. When provided, I(api_key_id) and I(api_private_key) are not required and the C(cryptography) Python library is not needed. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_BEARER_TOKEN environment variable is used.

options.name: api_key_id
options.description: Public API Key ID associated with the private key. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_KEY_ID environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not provided.

options.name: api_private_key
options.description: Filename (absolute path) or string of PEM formatted private key data to be used for Intersight API authentication. If a string is used, Ansible vault should be used to encrypt string data. Ex. ansible-vault encrypt_string --vault-id tme@/Users/dsoper/Documents/vault_password_file '-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----     <your private key data>     -----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----' If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not

options.name: api_uri
options.description: URI used to access the Intersight API. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_URI environment variable is used.

options.name: attribute
options.description: Role and locale information of the user. Required when state is present.

options.name: base_dn
options.description: Base Distinguished Name (DN). Starting point from where server will search for users and groups. Required when state is present.

options.name: bind_dn
options.description: Distinguished Name (DN) of the user, that is used to authenticate against LDAP servers. Required when bind_method is configuredcredentials.

options.name: bind_method
options.description: Authentication method to access LDAP servers. C(logincredentials) uses the user credentials entered at login. C(anonymous) uses no credentials to access the LDAP server. C(configuredcredentials) uses a specific set of credentials configured for the LDAP server.

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description for the LDAP Policy. Description can contain letters(a-z, A-Z), numbers(0-9), hyphen(-), period(.), colon(:), or an underscore(_).

options.name: dns_source
options.description: Source of the domain name used for the DNS SRV request. C(extracted) extracts the domain name from the login ID entered by the user. C(configured) uses the configured search domain. C(configuredextracted) uses configured search domain first, then extracted. Only applicable when enable_dns is true.

options.name: domain
options.description: The IPv4 domain that all users must be in. Required when state is present.

options.name: enable_dns
options.description: Enables DNS to access LDAP servers. When enabled, LDAP providers cannot be specified (DNS discovery is used instead). When disabled, at least one LDAP provider must be configured.

options.name: enable_encryption
options.description: If enabled, the endpoint encrypts all information it sends to the LDAP server.

options.name: enable_ldap
options.description: If enabled, LDAP server performs authentication.

options.name: filter
options.description: Criteria to identify entries in search requests. Required when state is present.

options.name: group_attribute
options.description: Groups to which an LDAP entry belongs. Required when state is present.

options.name: group_authorization
options.description: If enabled, user authorization is also done at the group level for LDAP users not in the local user database.

options.name: ldap_groups
options.description: List of LDAP groups to be created and attached to the LDAP policy. Each group defines the mapping between LDAP server groups and Intersight roles.

options.name: ldap_providers
options.description: List of LDAP providers (servers) to be created and attached to the LDAP policy. Providers define the LDAP servers to connect to. Cannot be specified when enable_dns is true (DNS discovery is used instead). Required when enable_dns is false (at least one provider must be specified).

options.name: name
options.description: The name assigned to the LDAP Policy. Must be unique within the organization. The name must be between 1 and 64 alphanumeric characters, allowing special characters :-_.

options.name: nested_group_search
options.description: If enabled, an extended search walks the chain of ancestry all the way to the root. Returns all the groups and subgroups, each of those groups belong to recursively.

options.name: nested_group_search_depth
options.description: Search depth to look for a nested LDAP group in an LDAP group map. Valid range is 1-128. Only applicable when nested_group_search is true.

options.name: organization
options.description: The name of the Organization this resource is assigned to. Policies created within a Custom Organization are applicable only to devices in the same Organization. Use 'default' for the default organization.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the user for initial bind process. Can have any character except spaces, tabs, line breaks. Cannot be more than 254 characters. Required when bind_method is configuredcredentials.

options.name: search_domain
options.description: Domain name that acts as a source for a DNS query. Required when dns_source is configured or configuredextracted.

options.name: search_forest
options.description: Forest name that acts as a source for a DNS query. Required when dns_source is configured or configuredextracted.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify the resource is present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify the resource is absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags in Key:<user-defined key> Value:<user-defined value> format.

options.name: timeout
options.description: LDAP authentication timeout duration, in seconds. Valid range is 0-180.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: user_search_precedence
options.description: Search precedence between local user database and LDAP user database. C(localuserdb) searches local user database first. C(ldapuserdb) searches LDAP user database first.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean control for verifying the api_uri TLS certificate
